title: Locus
description: A place a citation can point to: a numbered paragraph, a section heading or a footnote, with the printed pages it spans. Its words are a kit v1.3 snapshot, nested unchanged. A locus carries no status and no dependencies; those are kept in the status log and the dependency file and joined after retrieval. Kit v1.4. CC0 1.0.

label.description: How a citation names it: '¶6.22', 'Section heading (c)', 'footnote 6'.

printed_pages.description: Every printed page the locus appears on, in order. A paragraph that runs across a page has two.

footnotes.description: Ids of the footnotes whose markers appear in this locus.

anchored_in.description: For a footnote: the locus that carries its marker. null otherwise, or if no marker was found.
